text:
mira: Heads up, CI failing on sampleapps e2e after the project-key rotation test was added. looks like the node sampleapp still authenticates with the org key when both envs are present.

jas: which test exactly? can you paste the failing assertion / logs?

mira: failing test is `streams/rotation.spec.js` in sampleapps e2e. assertion expects reconnect to use proj_live_NEW but server sees org_live_OLD and returns 403. log excerpt:
```
2026-03-20T18:02:13Z INFO credentials: discovered REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_live_OLD
2026-03-20T18:02:13Z WARN credentials: both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set, using REDWOOD_API_KEY
2026-03-20T18:02:14Z ERROR stream: reconnect auth failed 403
```

olga: hmm. I thought we landed project-first discovery for all SDKs last quarter. maybe JS missed the change. which SDK version are the sampleapps pulling?

mira: sampleapps pulls @redwood/js-sdk v0.14.3. the python infra test harness uses py-sdk 0.14.3 and passes. clearly an impl gap.

mike: thanks. sounds like two immediate actions: 1) patch sampleapp e2e to be resilient while we fix SDK parity, 2) a small SDK patch to make discovery project-first but behind a compatibility flag so we don't break customers who relied on org-first behavior.

jas: for (2) we can add an env var override REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true that flips precedence without a code change for customers. then ship a minor release and flip the sampleapp to opt-in during the test.

olga: good idea. that gives ops time to migrate. can we also add a startup warning when both keys present so customers notice?

mira: yes, sampleapp e2e will assert on the warning and also exercise REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true in CI so we verify behavior.

cred-bot: Created issue devex/sdk-credentials#4302: "Add REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT env override + startup warning; ensure JS discovery honours flag on reconnect" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4302)

mike: timeline: jas can do the SDK flag in a small PR (target v0.14.4). olga can add the warning string. mira will update sampleapp CI to set REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT in the failing job and re-run. if tests green, we can cut the SDK patch release and then flip default to project-first in the next minor once telemetry looks good.

jas: quick patch sketch for JS discovery:
```
const preferProject = process.env.REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT === 'true';
const projectKey = process.env.REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY;
const orgKey = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
const key = preferProject ? (projectKey || orgKey) : (orgKey || projectKey);
```
I'll include a unit test for reconnect scenario.

olga: telemetry request: emit `credential.shadow_detected` with counts and a `prefer_project_opt_in` flag so we can see adoption. file as follow-up to #4302.

mira: also adding a small note in the onboarding README that long-lived streams can re-run discovery on reconnect and to prefer explicit config for production services.

mike: sounds good. prioritize SDK patch in this sprint, sampleapp CI change now, and then evaluate telemetry before flipping default. thanks team. :thumbsup:
